questions.question: Prometheus qanday ishlaydi: pull model, exporter, scrape?
questions.explanation: Prometheus har `scrape_interval`da target'larning `/metrics` endpoint'idan HTTP orqali metrikalarni tortadi (pull) va o'z TSDB'sida saqlaydi. Exporter — o'z metrikasini bermaydigan tizim uchun tarjimon (node_exporter, postgres_exporter).

questions.question: Prometheus metrika turlari: counter, gauge, histogram, summary?
questions.explanation: counter — faqat o'sadi (request soni), `rate()` bilan ishlatiladi; gauge — yuqoriga/pastga (xotira, navbat uzunligi); histogram — bucket'lar bo'yicha taqsimot (latency), server tomonda quantile; summary — client tomonda quantile, agregatsiya qilib bo'lmaydi.

questions.question: Asosiy PromQL so'rovlar: rate, sum by, histogram_quantile?
questions.explanation: `rate(counter[5m])` — sekundiga o'rtacha o'sish; `sum by (label)` — agregatsiya; `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(..._bucket[5m])))` — p99.

questions.question: `rate()` va `irate()` farqi, nega counter'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qaralmaydi?
questions.explanation: Counter faqat o'sadi va restart'da 0 ga tushadi — xom qiymat ma'nosiz. rate() oraliqdagi o'rtacha sekundlik o'sish (reset'ni hisobga oladi); irate() oxirgi ikki nuqta — sakrashli, alert'ga yaramaydi.

questions.question: Exporter nima? Eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlari?
questions.explanation: Exporter — tizim metrikasini Prometheus formatida /metrics da beradigan process. node_exporter (server), cAdvisor/kube-state-metrics (K8s), postgres/redis exporter, blackbox_exporter (tashqi probe).

questions.question: PromQL'da `increase()` va `rate()` farqi? Instant vector va range vector nima?
questions.explanation: rate — oraliqdagi sekundlik o'rtacha o'sish; increase — oraliqdagi umumiy o'sish (= rate × oraliq soniyalari). Range vector `x[5m]` — har series uchun nuqtalar to'plami; rate/increase uni instant vector'ga (bitta qiymat) aylantiradi.

questions.question: `up` metrikasi, `job` va `instance` label'lari nima?
questions.explanation: Prometheus har scrape uchun avtomatik `up` yaratadi: 1 — target javob berdi, 0 — scrape fail. `job` — scrape_config nomi, `instance` — target manzili. `up == 0` eng asosiy "exporter/servis o'ldi" alert'i.

questions.question: Label'lar va kardinallik: nega `user_id`ni label qilish xavfli?
questions.explanation: Har unikal label kombinatsiyasi = alohida time series. `user_id`, `request_id`, to'liq URL kabi chegarasiz qiymatlar millionlab series yaratadi — xotira, sekin so'rov, Prometheus OOM.

questions.question: Alerting qoidasi va Alertmanager qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Prometheus alert rule'ni baholaydi; shart `for` davomida rost bo'lsa alert firing bo'ladi va Alertmanager'ga yuboriladi. Alertmanager group/dedupe, route (jamoa bo'yicha), inhibit, silence va notify qiladi.

questions.question: Grafana'da yaxshi dashboard qanday quriladi?
questions.explanation: Yuqorida servis sog'ligi (RED: rate, errors, duration p50/p95/p99), keyin resurslar (USE), variable'lar (env, service), bir xil vaqt oralig'i, birliklar va threshold'lar. Dashboard kod sifatida (JSON/Terraform/provisioning).

questions.question: node_exporter bilan server monitoringi: qaysi metrikalarga qaraladi?
questions.explanation: CPU (usage, iowait, steal), load, memory (MemAvailable), disk (bo'sh joy, inode, IO util/latency), network (trafik, xatolar), filesystem read-only, systemd servislar.

questions.question: Kubernetes'da Prometheus target'larni qanday topadi? ServiceMonitor nima?
questions.explanation: kubernetes_sd_configs — K8s API'dan pod/service/endpoint'larni topadi, relabel bilan filtrlaydi. Prometheus Operator'da ServiceMonitor/PodMonitor CRD — label selector bilan deklarativ scrape.

questions.question: `relabel_configs` va `metric_relabel_configs` farqi?
questions.explanation: relabel_configs — scrape'dan OLDIN target'lar ustida ishlaydi (qaysi target scrape qilinadi, label'lar qanday nomlanadi). metric_relabel_configs — scrape'dan KEYIN har bir sample ustida (keraksiz metrika/label'ni tashlash, saqlashdan oldin).

questions.question: Kubernetes'da container CPU va memory foydalanishini requests/limits'ga nisbatan foizda qanday hisoblaysiz (PromQL)?
questions.explanation: cAdvisor counter'i `container_cpu_usage_seconds_total`dan rate olinadi va kube-state-metrics'dagi requests/limits bilan bo'linadi. Memory uchun `container_memory_working_set_bytes` (OOM shu bo'yicha).

questions.question: Alertmanager config'ni noto'g'ri o'zgartirib, prod alert'lari ishlamay qoldi. Bunday holatni qanday oldini olasiz?
questions.explanation: Config Git'da, CI'da `amtool check-config` va `promtool check rules`, routing testi (`amtool config routes test`). Deploy'dan keyin doim yonib turadigan Watchdog alert va tashqi dead man's switch — alert zanjiri o'lsa xabar beradi.

questions.question: Recording rule va alerting rule farqi? Recording rule qachon kerak?
questions.explanation: Recording rule — og'ir PromQL natijasini oldindan hisoblab yangi metrika sifatida saqlaydi (dashboard tez, alert sodda). Alerting rule — shart bajarilsa alert yaratadi. Ikkalasi ham `evaluation_interval` bo'yicha hisoblanadi.

questions.question: Prometheus'ni HA (yuqori mavjud) qanday qilasiz? Retention va disk qanday hisoblanadi?
questions.explanation: Klassik usul: bir xil config bilan ikkita Prometheus replika, Alertmanager klasteri (o'zi dublikat alertlarni yo'qotadi). So'rovda dublikatni olib tashlash uchun Thanos Querier/Mimir. Retention vaqt yoki hajm bo'yicha; disk ≈ sample/s × sample hajmi × vaqt.

questions.question: Grafana'da templating variable'lar va annotation'lar nima uchun?
questions.explanation: Variable — dashboard tepasidagi dropdown (namespace, service, instance): bitta dashboard ko'p servis uchun. Annotation — grafikda vertikal belgi (deploy, incident): "latency deploy'dan keyin oshdimi?" savoliga darhol javob.

questions.question: Exemplar nima va metrikadan trace'ga qanday o'tiladi?
questions.explanation: Exemplar — histogram sample'iga biriktirilgan trace_id. Grafana grafigida latency sakrashidagi nuqtani bosib, aynan shu sekin so'rovning trace'ini (Tempo/Jaeger) ochish mumkin — metrika va trace orasida ko'prik.

questions.question: Prometheus'ni scale qilish va uzoq muddat saqlash: federation, remote_write, Thanos/Mimir?
questions.explanation: Bitta Prometheus vertikal scale bo'ladi va lokal disk (odatda 15-30 kun). Ko'p cluster va uzoq retention uchun: remote_write yoki Thanos sidecar orqali object storage'ga, global query (Thanos/Mimir/VictoriaMetrics), HA juftlik + dedupe.

questions.question: Prometheus'da staleness nima? Target yo'qolganda grafikda nima bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: Series 5 daqiqa (lookback delta) davomida yangi sample olmasa yoki target scrape'dan yo'qolsa, Prometheus unga stale marker yozadi — series grafikda darhol uziladi. Busiz oxirgi qiymat 5 daqiqa "osilib" ko'rinardi.

questions.question: Thanos arxitekturasi: Sidecar, Store Gateway, Querier, Compactor, Ruler nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: Sidecar — Prometheus yonida, 2 soatlik blok'larni object storage'ga yuklaydi va so'nggi data'ni beradi. Store Gateway — eski blok'larni S3'dan o'qib beradi. Querier — hammasidan so'rab, replika dublikatlarini olib tashlaydi (global view). Compactor — blok'larni birlashtiradi, downsampling, retention. Ruler — global data ustida rule/alert.

questions.question: Prometheus konfiguratsiyasida scrape job qanday yoziladi?
questions.explanation: `scrape_configs` ichida `job_name` va target'lar.

questions.question: node_exporter nima ko'rsatadi?
questions.explanation: Linux host metrikalari: CPU, RAM, disk, tarmoq, filesystem.

questions.question: CPU ishlatilishi % ni PromQL bilan qanday hisoblaysiz?
questions.explanation: 100 minus idle rejimining o'rtacha rate'i.

questions.question: Disk bo'sh joyi 10% dan kam bo'lsa alert qoidasi?
questions.explanation: Prometheus alerting rule: `expr`, `for`, `labels`, `annotations`.

questions.question: Alertmanager vazifasi nima?
questions.explanation: Prometheus'dan kelgan alert'larni guruhlaydi, takrorni o'chiradi, silence qiladi va Slack/Telegram/email/PagerDuty'ga yuboradi.

questions.question: Grafana'da data source va dashboard nima?
questions.explanation: Data source — ma'lumot manbai (Prometheus, Loki). Dashboard — panellar to'plami, har panel so'rov + vizualizatsiya.

questions.question: Label nima va high cardinality nega xavfli?
questions.explanation: Label — metrikani ajratuvchi kalit-qiymat. Har noyob kombinatsiya alohida time series; user_id kabi label millionlab series yaratib Prometheus'ni o'ldiradi.

questions.question: Blackbox exporter nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqaridan tekshiradi: HTTP, TCP, ICMP, DNS — sayt ochiladimi, sertifikat muddati qancha.

questions.question: Prometheus metrikalarini ilovadan qanday chiqarasiz?
questions.explanation: Client library (Go, Python) bilan `/metrics` endpoint ochiladi, Prometheus uni scrape qiladi.

questions.question: Prometheus ma'lumotni qancha saqlaydi?
questions.explanation: Default 15 kun (`--storage.tsdb.retention.time`). Uzoq muddat uchun Thanos/Mimir/VictoriaMetrics.
